title: OpenAI study finds AI-assisted tasks are broadening workers’ roles
friendlyTitle: AI is helping workers take on tasks outside their usual roles
summary: An analysis of more than 1.5 million work-related ChatGPT messages found workers repeatedly using AI for tasks outside their usual occupations. Among a consistently observed group, previously used cross-occupation tasks rose from 13.1% to 25.9% of occupation-specific AI activity between April and July.
friendlySummary: OpenAI found that some workers keep using ChatGPT for work normally done by another type of job. These new tasks can become part of their regular routine.
whyItMatters: Jobs may change through a widening mix of tasks before titles or organisation charts change. Teams should pair access to AI with workflow design, review standards and training for unfamiliar work rather than assuming the tool supplies expertise safely by itself.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Your job may change before your title changes. Training and careful checking matter when AI helps you work in an unfamiliar area.
